zh.title: 亞馬遜Prime Air塗裝波音767貨機於邁阿密衝出跑道釀5死
zh.summary: 亞馬遜Prime Air塗裝波音767貨機於邁阿密衝出跑道釀5死；據報觸地過快
body: 一架帶有亞馬遜Prime Air（Amazon Prime Air）品牌的波音767-300F貨機，在邁阿密降落時發生衝出跑道事故。根據報導，該起事故已造成5人死亡。
這架貨機係由21 Air負責實際營運。報導指出，飛機在觸地時的速度據報高於正常水準，隨後在邁阿密跑道發生衝出狀況。
該新聞由Simple Flying於2026年9月6日發布。有關邁阿密衝出跑道事故的確切原因與詳細經過，仍有待航空安全權責單位進行調查與釐清。

en.title: Amazon Prime Air-Branded Boeing 767-300F Overruns Runway in Miami Leaving 5 Dead
en.summary: An Amazon Prime Air-branded Boeing 767-300F overran a runway in Miami, leaving five dead.
body: An Amazon Prime Air-branded Boeing 767-300F freighter aircraft overran a runway during landing in Miami, resulting in five fatalities according to reporting from industry sources.

The cargo aircraft was operated by 21 Air at the time of the event. Initial reports indicate that the Boeing 767-300F reportedly touched down on the runway at a speed faster than normal operational parameters prior to overrunning the runway end.

The occurrence was published by Simple Flying on September 6, 2026. Detailed findings regarding the precise operational circumstances and official causes of the runway overrun remain subject to ongoing investigation by aviation safety authorities.
